head: gallery_grade
sampler: w_class[1/sqrt] x w_place[1/pictures at this place], in that order
augmentation: geometric only — border crop and both flips. No colour and no JPEG jitter: the colouring is what the grade is about
selection: max AP(>=3) over the stopping slice, ranked by p_ge3, with AUC(>=3) as the fallback where the slice holds one class
conditioning: none — the picture is the input, and the head is told no batch
cascade: stage two behind the render judge's p_ge4. Undefined on a row that never cleared the gate; never a pool-wide ranker

initialised_from.says: a COPY. Never a shared trunk — a moved trunk is a judge flip

freezing.says: the last block stage and the pointwise head above it. Half the net by parameter count, because conv_head alone is 49% of this backbone

chosen.was: 1280x720 — the sheet picture a verdict was cast on
chosen.why: this head is read where a seating reads, and the two geometries are not resamplings of each other: they correlate at r = 0.696 over the landed thousand, with 55 rows under P(>=4) 0.5 at label geometry and none at candidate geometry. Fitting at the deployment column accepts a label-quality cost on purpose

chosen.now: lineages whole, and the holdout filled to balance the three BATCHES
chosen.why: the three sittings disagree at p = 2.6e-05 and the strata were near-identical by construction, so a stopping slice over-weighting one sitting would stop on a scale the training side is not on

chosen.was: the run's own seed, so each seed sits on its own slice
chosen.now: fixed at 0 for every arm and every seed
chosen.why: the question here is WHICH ARM, and models/render/README.md says why the incumbent arrangement cannot answer it: an AP read on two different slices is not a comparison of two heads. The training seed still moves the initialisation and the sampler order

not_inherited.why: the backbone is not re-initialised from ImageNet at all — it starts at the shipped weights-v6 artifact, which is what makes this a second stage rather than a second judge
the render judge is told no kind and this head is told no batch. The corpus is one store with one scale

split.rule: a seeded 80%/20% over LINEAGES, filled by whichever remaining lineage most reduces the per-BATCH shortfall. The holdout's only job is to stop the run — it is the shipped judge's split with one seed for every arm, so nine runs are read on one slice
